summary: Verified three.js 0.186 + WebGPURenderer→WebGL2 fallback swap. All three 3D scenes (PublicGate multiverse, Command Deck multiverse, Admin DigitalTwin) render <canvas> with non-zero size in the headless Chromium (no WebGPU → forceWebGL fallback path). No JavaScript pageerrors and no non-401 console errors captured across all flows. Admin login via UI completes successfully (header shows 'Michele'). Clicking machine spheres in the DigitalTwin does not throw.
